# Version 4.157.1 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan driver error handling**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.1 avoids unsafe Vulkan descriptor-pool destruction after allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Safer Vulkan out-of-memory handling on Imagination** — Ganesh and Graphite abandon affected descriptor pools after host or device out-of-memory errors rather than destroying them in an unsafe state. Graphite also rejects subsequent allocations through a null pool handle. This driver workaround deliberately trades pool cleanup for safety. ([#5838](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5838))
